text:
Which components are used to construct an efficient simple transformer?
A
two insulated copper wire coils wound on a copper core
B
two insulated copper wire coils wound on an iron core
C
two insulated iron wire coils wound on a copper core
D
two insulated iron wire coils wound on an iron core

options.label: A
options.text: two insulated copper wire coils wound on a copper core

options.label: B
options.text: two insulated copper wire coils wound on an iron core

options.label: C
options.text: two insulated iron wire coils wound on a copper core

options.label: D
options.text: two insulated iron wire coils wound on an iron core
